## setup
```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)

data(PimaIndiansDiabetes)
df <- tibble(PimaIndiansDiabetes)

# Set target variable
df <- df %>%
  rename(target = diabetes)

# Split data into training and testing
set.seed(123)

splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df$target, p = .70,
                                  list = FALSE)

df_train <- df[splitIndex, 
df_test <- df[-splitIndex, ]

```{r}

##Q1######################################################

# Decision Tree
model1 <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
                method = "rpart")

pred1 <- predict(model1, df_test)

cm1 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred1,
                       reference = df_test$target,
                       positive = "pos")

cm1$overall[1]

# Variable Importance
plot(varImp(model1))


# Random Forest
model2 <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
                method = "rf",
                ntree = 100)

pred2 <- predict(model2, df_test)

cm2 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred2,
                       reference = df_test$target,
                       positive = "pos")

cm2$overall[1]

# Variable Importance
plot(varImp(model2))

##Q2######################################################
# GLMNET
model3 <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
                method = "glmnet")

pred3 <- predict(model3, df_test)

cm3 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred3,
                       reference = df_test$target,
                       positive = "pos")

cm3$overall[1]

# Variable Importance
plot(varImp(model3))


##Q3######################################################

# Support Vector Machine
model4 <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
                method = "svmRadial",
                preProcess = c("center", "scale"))

pred4 <- predict(model4, df_test)

cm4 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred4,
                       reference = df_test$target,
                       positive = "pos")

cm4$overall[1]

# Variable Importance
plot(varImp(model4))


# K-Nearest Neighbors
model5 <- train(target ~ ., data = df_train,
                method = "knn",
                preProcess = c("center", "scale"))

pred5 <- predict(model5, df_test)

cm5 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred5,
                       reference = df_test$target,
                       positive = "pos")

cm5$overall[1]

# Variable Importance
plot(varImp(model5))
